## Personality

Gertie Pye has a habit of being late. She is also prone to saying nasty things about Julia behind her back, leading others to believe she is jealous of her.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P47](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0047)_

## History

During a meeting of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), Gertie Pye announced that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) planned to rent his fence to a medicine company to display painted advertisements. Her announcement prompted a committee of girls to attempt, unsuccessfully, to dissuade Parker from going through with the plan.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gertie-pye--jane-andrews.md)

Gertie Pye and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) serve together as fellow canvassing committee members for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). During a society meeting, Gertie reports local news about [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) renting his fence for medicine ads, which leads to a committee of the local girls attempting to intervene.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), +2 more_

- Comrade of — canvassing committee members for the Improvement Society (since v2)  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010)</sub>

### [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gertie-pye--josie-pye.md)

Gertie Pye is a member of the [Pye](../codex/factions.md#pyes) family and the sister of [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md). The two share ties through their family connection and involvement in Avonlea's local social circle, including attending community events like the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) farewell gathering.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P90](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0090), [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P3](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0003), +3 more_

- Relative of — sister / member of the Pye family (since v2)  _(ended v2)_  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P90](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0090)</sub>
- Sibling of (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Autumn P3](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0003)</sub>
